Priya: Kicking off cloud marketplace listing onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: initial listing + trial SKU + basic KMS/role instructions this sprint. Use this thread for quick Qs.
Marco: For AWS we need a sample assume-role ARN and a note about `kms:GenerateDataKey` if using envelope encryption. I'll add a CFN snippet later.
Ellen: Legal: need EULA excerpt + export control line and EU data residency checkbox for Azure. We'll provide templated language by Tue.
Infra-bot: Reminder: staging publisher creds expire in 2 days. Run `gcloud auth list` / `aws sts get-caller-identity` to verify.
Devrel: Packaging constraints: GCP tar <=200MB, hero 1200x628, icons 512x512. Also include SHA256 in manifest.
Design: Uploading hero + icons to `partnerships-drive/marketplace/assets-v2` by Thu.
Legal: We'll also flag refund/retention blurbs for trial conversion flows.
Ops: After artifacts land we'll run a staging deploy and smoke test. Assigning to oncall for verification.
Priya: Action list: Marco CFN+IAM, Legal copy, Design assets, Devrel manifest. Check back when done.
